name: SaiPad Studio & Professional 4x4 Macropad
changelog: v1.5.1 - ⚡ Dual-Corner Hold (Key 13 + 16 for 2000ms): Hold both bottom corners together for deliberate profile cycle without accidental switching
v1.5.1 - 🎯 Directional Profile Switch (Key 13 + 4 / Key 13 + 1): Hold Key 13 and tap Key 4 to cycle forward, or tap Key 1 to cycle backward
v1.5.1 - Tagged Firmware Binary: Added explicit version tag in binary filename (4x4keyboard_rp2040_zero_v1.5.1.uf2) for instant identification
v1.5.1 - Deliberate Profile Switch Hold Time (2000ms): Increased default hold threshold from 1.2s to 2.0s (range 800ms-5000ms) to eliminate accidental switching during fast typing

v1.5.1 - USB Keystroke Script & Command Injection (KT_SCRIPT = 5): Injects Windows Run (Win+R) commands to launch terminals (wt), VS Code (code .), Calculator (calc), Explorer, or custom PowerShell/CMD scripts in 1 tap without native software
v1.5.1 - 💾 1990s Vintage Keyboard Theme (IBM Model M): Authentic retro beige workstation styling with 3D stepped PBT keycaps, vintage typography, and LED indicator panel
v1.5.1 - 🔊 IBM Model M Buckling Spring Sound Synthesizer: Procedural Web Audio API sound engine modeling metallic spring resonance ping and tactile plastic bottom-out
v1.5.1 - 🤖 AI Keymap Copilot: Interactive prompt generator for ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini with full JSON schema + 1-click JSON validator and flash importer

v1.5.1 - 🎨 Per-Preset RGB Colors & Revamped 8-Pack: Interactive color pickers on every preset card; curated packs for Power Users, Devs, 90s Accounting, Designers, Video Editors, Streamers, AI Engineers, and Gamers
v1.5.1 - ⚡ WebSerial Zero-Click Auto-Reconnect: Remembers paired device and automatically connects when page opens or USB is plugged in without opening the device picker dialog
v1.5.1 - 📱 PWA Desktop App Installation: Full web app manifest supporting standalone window installation right from Chrome and Edge
v1.5.0 - VIA / Keychron Style Studio Navigation & Matrix Tester
v1.4.1 - Active Profile & Settings Hardware Persistence auto-commit to Flash EEPROM
v1.4.0 - Direct Profile Jump (Hold #16 + #1..#4) & 2-Key Combo Switch
